scope: Notion DelegationRequest -> future Qwen coding-subagent adapter

facts: Notion validate_delegation_request accepts max_model_turns from 1 through 24.

Qwen taskSettings uses clampInteger(..., 1, HARD_MAX_ROUNDS), so an adapter that passes max_model_turns=13..24 through as maxRounds silently executes at 12 rather than preserving or rejecting the parent contract.

recommended_adapter_contract: Do not silently clamp a provider-neutral request.
Before provider work, reject target=qwen requests above Qwen's proven max with a provider-capability error, or explicitly negotiate/store effective_max_model_turns in a structured delegation result.
Keep validation before provider/local side effects so an unsupported budget cannot partially start a child task.
